prompt: Camera a hand's width above black water, 24mm lens, close off the stern quarter of a small wooden skiff crossing the frame at night. A slim Filipino American deckhand of about 28 sits at the oars, three-quarter to us and leaning toward the lens: wide cheekbones, small flat nose, narrow chin, smooth clean-shaven skin, hatless, soaked black hair stuck to his forehead, wet undershirt. His face fills a third of the frame, oar handles low below his chest. Far behind him the crew's own boat burns against a timber pier, orange fire spilling across the water toward us. A cold blue-green lantern on the skiff's stern seat lights his mouth from below. The water runs unbroken to the frame's edges. Thanks.
